title: transparency-statements-v1 player output
description: The extracted transparency field map. present/absent for COI + funding; available / on_request / url for the open-practices fields; a real repository URL (string) or null. confidence is the player's overall confidence in the extraction.

present.description: True if a competing-interests/COI statement is present.

statement.description: The COI statement text (empty if absent).

present.description: True if a funding statement is present.

statement.description: The funding statement text (empty if absent).

available.description: True if the preregistration is openly available at a real link.

url.description: The preregistration URL (a real registry link), or null.

confidence.description: Player's overall confidence in the extracted field map.

available.description: True only if openly available at a REAL repository link (not on-request, not a placeholder/broken URL).

on_request.description: True if the manuscript says the artifact is 'available on request' rather than giving a real link.

url.description: The repository URL the manuscript quotes (may be a placeholder/broken link), or null.
